title: ScaleHint
description: Structured disambiguation of a raw drawing scale string into a numeric ratio, produced as a fallback when the backend's deterministic regex scale parser cannot confidently resolve the scale_text extracted from a title block.

scale_ratio.description: The drawing scale expressed as a single dimensionless ratio of real-world units per drawing unit, e.g. a '1:100' scale is 100, and a '1/4"=1'-0"' scale is 48. Null if the raw text gives no derivable ratio (e.g. 'AS SHOWN' or illegible text).

unit_system.description: Which unit convention the original scale text was expressed in. Null if it cannot be determined or is not applicable (e.g. 'NTS').

confidence.description: Confidence in the derived scale_ratio and unit_system, from 0 (pure guess) to 1 (unambiguous).

reasoning.description: A brief one or two sentence explanation of how scale_ratio was derived from the raw text, or why it could not be derived.
